LineItems.Includes: Includes: Your federal 1040, your first state return and your first local return; Wages, interest and dividends; Itemized deductions; One brokerage statement; Up to two K-1s you receive; One gig Schedule C on standard mileage; One full Schedule C business.

Assumptions.Text: Brokerage — your 1099-Bs can be summarized rather than keyed line by line. If a statement is disordered enough that it has to be keyed, the additional time is billed at $150 an hour as it is worked.

Foreign entities — your foreign holdings are accounts rather than companies. If you hold an interest in a foreign corporation or partnership, the additional time is billed at $150 an hour as it is worked.
Records cleanup — your records arrive complete and reconciled. If the records need reconciling before the return can be prepared, the additional time is billed at $150 an hour as it is worked.
